svg.title: How IBM counts MaaS360
svg.desc: How IBM counts MaaS360: Fast Start, mobile device and app management for smaller businesses, per client device per month; the Essentials, Deluxe, Premier and Enterprise editions, each adding to the one before, per client device per month; Mobile Security Suite, listed by IBM as SaaS, per managed client device per month.
